text: Resinee -onon gomɗinɓe ɓen- ɓen worɓe ɓe alah sonnaaɓe, e ɓen rimɓe ɓe alaa moodiɓɓe, resinee gomɗinɓe ɓen immorde e maccuɓe mooɗon ɓen e horɓe mooɗon ɓen kadi, si tawii ko ɓe waasuɓe Alla alɗiniray ɓe Ɓural Makko yaajungal ngal, Alla ko O Yaajuɗo Arsike, alɗinngol goɗɗo uytataa Arsike Makko on, ko O Annduɗo alhaaliiji jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen.
